description: A Python script implementing a Streamlit-based chatbot that integrates with OpenAI and Google Generative AI models to generate SQL queries and answers based on a school database schema. It manages environment variables, database connections, model initialization, and user interaction for query processing and response generation.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string combining user question and additional context for model input.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a message to OpenAI's chat completion API and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and returns fetched rows.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Constructs a detailed prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from a GEMINI model response object.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates total token-based cost for query and answer responses.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main Streamlit app function managing user interaction, query generation, data retrieval, and response display.
